typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		hash as string,
		toc_status as string,
		response_flag as string,
		file_name as string,
		file_created_date as string,
		PREGNANT_FL as string,
		MEMBER_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT MEMBER_ID, [hash]   			,[toc_status] 			,[response_flag] 			,[file_name] 			,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),CREATE_DATE  ,120) as file_created_date 			,PREGNANT_FL 	 from [Data_Exchange].[EXTRACT].[OH_TOC_Extract]  ##OH_TOC_EXTRACT',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceTableOHTOCEXTRACT	source(output(
		hash as string,
		toc_status as string,
		response_flag as string,
		file_name as string,
		file_created_date as string,
		PREGNANT_FL as string,
		MEMBER_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT MEMBER_ID, [hash]   			,[toc_status] 			,CASE WHEN PREGNANT_FL=\'Y\' THEN \'true\' 			 ELSE \'false\' END AS [response_flag] 			,CASE WHEN PREGNANT_FL=\'Y\' THEN [file_name] 			 ELSE \'\' END AS [file_name] 			,CASE WHEN PREGNANT_FL=\'Y\' THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),CREATE_DATE  ,120) 			 ELSE \'\' END AS file_created_date 			,PREGNANT_FL 	 from [Data_Exchange].[EXTRACT].[OH_TOC_Extract]  ##OH_TOC_EXTRACT',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceTableOHTOCEXTRACT1
SourceTableOHTOCEXTRACT derive(file_name = file_name + '_PCP.csv') ~> DeriveFileName
SourceTableOHTOCEXTRACT1 derive(file_name = iif(PREGNANT_FL == 'Y', file_name + '_PM.csv', '')) ~> DerivedFileName1
DeriveFileName sink(input(
		response_flag as string,
		file_name as string,
		file_created_date as string,
		toc_status as string,
		hash as string,
		recipient_id as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		response_flag,
		file_name,
		file_created_date,
		toc_status,
		hash,
		recipient_id = MEMBER_ID)) ~> VantageFilePCPMember
DerivedFileName1 sink(input(
		response_flag as string,
		file_name as string,
		file_created_date as string,
		toc_status as string,
		hash as string,
		recipient_id as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		response_flag,
		file_name,
		file_created_date,
		toc_status,
		hash,
		recipient_id = MEMBER_ID)) ~> VantageFilePCPPM
